structured_output.what_is_happening: A community-takeover (CTO) pump.fun coin from Dec 2025, "The Poke Kid" ($Avery, described as "All fees to Avery"), went from about $5k to $18k market cap (+283% h1) this morning. It references Avery "the Poke Kid", a 12-year-old Pokémon creator with more than 600k followers who died of cancer on Sept 18, 2026 (Yahoo/Dexerto coverage). Copycat tokens were created around 10:50 UTC, one named "The Poke Kid posted a CA" and another "READ HE MADE COIN". That suggests the family-run @averythepokekid X account posted a contract address shortly before the trigger. Search snippets of that account mention a CoinMarketCap listing request with a Dex link, alongside criticism that the original coin creator scammed people, including the family. Taken together, this is consistent with the family endorsing this CTO token.

narrative.description: The death of a viral child Pokémon creator (Sept 18) is combined with an apparent endorsement or CA post by the family-run official X account for a fee-sharing CTO coin, with fees going to Avery.
narrative.why_spreading: A real, widely covered event (Yahoo, Dexerto) plus an apparent official-account CA post this morning. Copycat tokens named after that post appeared about 25 minutes before the trigger.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the original, older CTO token with 'All fees to Avery', the only same-name token with meaningful liquidity. Its socials link to the official X/TikTok/IG accounts. It is likely the token the family account referenced (CMC listing request plus Dex link in the X snippet).
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 same-name clones (AVERY / The Poke Kid / RIP Avery / 'The Poke Kid posted a CA'), all under $6k mcap with roughly zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: Organic parts: a real event and an apparent official-account post. Promotional parts: a paid DexScreener ad and boost, 751 GMGN bundler-tagged wallets, a 50% bot/degen rate, and a 4-wallet insider transfer network. The 189 unique buyers in h1 is a decent number.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the actual X post (HTTP 402), so I can't confirm that the family named this exact CA rather than only criticising meme coins.

structural_risks: 751 bundler-tagged wallets and a 50% bot/degen rate
